open_issues: Length is about 3:33 at the tool's 2.35 words per second pace, slightly over the 3:30 target (485 words, 25 beats). If real voice runs long, cut k03 (Lightning settings) first, then p04.
Wallboard and phone views for Gas and Lightning are not in the video: changes.json says live, but no frame shows them. A capture is needed to feature them.

Gas Compliance (u-gas-compliance-c) was dropped for length. Also dropped: gear popup, details drawer, Gas Detectors table, Safety Policy band ribbon and cards. Compliance wording is in beatsheet.md if a slot is wanted.

Lightning alarm history as a named feature is not shown: no frame captures the alarm history table. The radii and the 24 hour state history are shown in k03; the radii map is only in the tri crop and is blurred.
The captured gas frame does not contain 'Not confirmed safe: 1 detector not reporting'. s01 uses the visible text instead: Check, Readiness Not ready, offline detector.
Umbrella stages 4, 5 and 7 (devices row, path pills, agent card) are skipped on purpose. Their text is defined in spec.json but never rendered. The paths and agent diagrams cover those ideas.

The green 'Last reading was N minute(s) ago' line under the offline headline is still visible, small, in the full-width u-ws-a shot (c01). The strip and its button cannot be zoomed without it. It is never called out.
Frames show station names ('Main Plant Weather Station', 'SCC Weather Station'). The capture notes treat these as acceptable. Please confirm 'SCC' is not a site name that must be hidden.

vbuild.py behaviour, not edited: (1) callout labels with pos l or inr are placed using the unscaled label width but drawn scaled by 1/zoom, so on zoomed shots they drift away from the box or fall outside the visible window. I used pos a, b and r instead. (2) The 5px callout border covers the first glyphs of tight rects, so callout rects need about 6 px padding. (3) A later diagram group never reveals stages it does not contain, so umbrella stages 6 or 7 cannot be shown in a second scene without earlier stages. (4) Agent stage 2 draws an arrow from the 'knows' list, so stage 1 cannot be skipped.
assumptions: Gas cadence ('about every minute') and 'vendor cloud, black box, no mesh, no Modbus' come from the brief's guardrail 5. The matching research claims G03 and G02 are live_today unknown and G12 is no. The narration gives no 45 second or 30 minute figure.

Umbrella chips are limited to: one backend, one menu and header, same view permission, switched on per project. They rest on X01, X02, X05 and the shared header in u-ws-c. No 'one rule set', 'one audit trail' or 'one permission for everything'.
'New' is used only where changes.json says live_in_1_0_5 yes and a frame shows it: Connected Products, gas status line in the header, Maximum Values Report, 30 day preview, Safety Policy in Settings.

The AI agent section is DIRECTION only. It says the connection exists for Weather Station only, Lightning and Gas are not connected, and no assistant runs on any site today. Only a person approves and safety answers come from fixed rules. It gives no tool counts and shows no agent screens.
Project A, B and C labels in the tri are frame suffixes, not names. The video never presents the three projects as one site.
No time or date is narrated, so the Saudi time question does not arise. The Held for duration is not narrated, and the tri crop of u-lightning-b stops above the Held for box.
Click callouts (c01 steps button, z01 rail icon) are demonstrations. Nothing was clicked, saved, acknowledged, closed or switched on in capture.

found.issue: Lightning alerting radii are presented as a control: the beat sits in the Control chapter, the narration opens 'Each product has its own controls. Lightning has alerting radii...', the caption says 'Each product has its own controls', and the callout reads 'Alerting radii'. The frame also shows, legibly in the zoom, the page line 'These are the radii the alerting service uses on this project. A change applies to one device only, and takes effect on its next reading.' Research says this is an unresolved conflict: the backend treats radii as DISPLAY-ONLY, the device itself decides state, and editing radii does not reconfigure the physical detector. Guardrail 6 says rings and radii are reference only. The beat evidence says the page line is 'not narrated (open question L10)', but it is on screen in the shot, so the contradiction is shown and endorsed by the 'controls' framing.
found.evidence_checked: captures/u-settings-lightning-b.txt (line present); preview frame k03 (line readable); integration-and-devices#L10 caveats ('CONFLICT to resolve before narrating ... Do not claim that editing radii in the portal reconfigures the physical detector'); open_questions item 3; u-lightning-b 'Zone reference only, not a live strike position'; agent-and-control control_paths 'Lightning alarm distances'.
found.suggested_fix: Remove radii from the 'controls' list. Say what is certain: 'Lightning Settings holds a Temporary sensor location and the last 24 hours of state history, which you can export.' If radii are named, call them 'the configured alert distances shown on the tile' and keep them reference-only. Zoom so the 'radii the alerting service uses' sentence is not on screen (start the zoom below the intro line), or get the product owner's decision first.

found.issue: Narration 'Your site team uses it to watch the site, decide, and control what happens when anything happens.' 'Control what happens when anything happens' is an unsupported absolute. Gas alarm limits are read-only; gas has no notifications and no Observation Manager link; Lightning radii are reference-only and Lightning email/SMS were removed. A customer would hear that the product acts on or routes any event.

open_issues: Length is tight: 340 words, est 2:29 against a 2:30 ceiling. If the real Aoede voice runs slower than 2.35 words per second, trim g06, g11 or g14 (each 25 to 27 words).

The dry render prints '14 warning(s)' from the render step without listing them (0 errors, --check is clean). I could not see what they are; probably the same lint noise as other videos, but the lead should check.

vbuild camera: zoom scale is floored at 1.15, so a beat cannot zoom out below that. For the wallboard (g06) I removed the zoom so the full headline block is visible; callouts there act as the camera target.

Callout label placement: labels use 'inr' on the Overview tiles and I relabelled the Acknowledged tile 'Handled' (g03, g10) because the long label covered the value '15'. No vbuild bug, just a layout limit.

Frame defects left as is: the 2 px black strip under the top bar (cap_clean) is visible on the zoomed shots. g-alerts-bottom-c.png is 1920x988 although captures.json says the raw was 1920x1600; rects in captures.json match the 988 version, so it works.
Not shown or not narrated by design: Needs attention filter, Trends (Planned), Zones, CO and CO2, g-mobile-desktopview-c, Peak today and Longest quiet gap. No missing frame was needed.

Research items still unverified and affecting wording: G03 (poll about every minute, detectors about every half hour) is live_today unknown; the Close/Acknowledge backend deploy is unverified (the page text and visible Close buttons support the claim). Both are phrased softly.

g14 states 'not the site's wireless mesh' for gas, based on integration-and-devices#G12 (live_today no for a mesh path) and the brief's guardrail; the reviewer may prefer to drop the clause if it feels like an extra claim.
assumptions: Gas reaches WakeCap only through the manufacturer's cloud; WakeCap asks about every minute (45 s default, not spoken) and detectors report about every half hour (integration-and-devices#G03, #G12, #G02).
Gas alarm limits are read-only (guardrail); the video only says the page lists the limits in force.

'Alerts now has a Close control' and the New caption rely on changes#gas-ack-close (yes) and visible Close buttons; nothing was clicked, so click callouts are demonstrations ('You can click', 'This is where you click').
Wallboard and phone pages are not linked from the rail, so the chapter path reads 'Gas wallboard and phone pages' without claiming a click route.
'Not confirmed safe' appears only as a quote of the page text (g06 narration and caption); the word safe is never used about the site otherwise.
Only live value spoken: five detectors, four online, one offline (on screen and the point). Serial numbers, times and the 15 acknowledged count are not read aloud.
No beat is DIRECTION: no AI agent, gas notifications, Observation Manager, vendor write-back, compliance numbers, CO/CO2 or Zones are mentioned.

contradictions.videos: lightning (l09a, l09b, l10) internal, vs l04 and research L10

contradictions.videos: weather-station (w02, w05, w07 openings; w08) vs connected-environment (all tri/crop choices) vs guardrails 7 and the no-names rule
contradictions.issue: The two videos treat the same frames in opposite ways. The umbrella rebuilt scenes as tri crops so that station names and the green 'Last reading was 1 minute(s) ago' line under the offline headline never appear. The Weather video shows both. In the dry render, w02, w05 and w07 each open on the whole page for about half a second, with the Stations list ('Main Plant Weather Station', 'SCC Weather Station') and the green line under the offline station. w08 holds the report tiles with those names ('SCC Weather Station', 'Main Plant Weather Station') for the entire beat. The Weather beatsheet claims these are 'framed out'. The umbrella decided names must be hidden. Weather leaves it as an open question.
contradictions.fix: Decide once for all four. If the names are generic device labels, say so and relax the umbrella. Otherwise mask or crop w08. Start w02, w05 and w07 already zoomed, or from a frame without the Stations list, so the contradicting green line never shows.

wording_inconsistencies: Navigation path wording differs. Weather: 'Left rail > Weather Station', 'Left rail > Reports', 'Left rail > Settings > Weather Station'. Lightning: 'Left rail > Lightning'. Gas: 'Left rail > Connected Environment > Gas > Dashboard'. Umbrella: 'Portal left rail > Connected Environment'. 'Left rail' means the portal icon rail in the gas and umbrella videos and the micro-app's own menu in weather and lightning. The captures show weather and gas items inside the Connected Environment menu.

Umbrella chapter bars 'Connected Environment > Weather Station, Lightning, Gas' (chapters 2 and 3) read as one menu holding all three. No frame has all three. Projects A, B and C each hold different products, and the umbrella itself says 'Switched on per project'.

Every spec has the same title 'Connected Environment'. The eyebrows differ: Weather 'WEATHER STATION', Lightning 'LIGHTNING . CONNECTED ENVIRONMENT', Gas 'GAS . CONNECTED ENVIRONMENT'. Weather alone drops the umbrella tag.

Weather lane is labelled three ways. Umbrella: 'WIRELESS MESH . MODBUS STYLE FRAMES', steps 'on-site radio network / decoded and stored / Weather Station readings and status'. Weather video: 'ON-SITE MESH', steps 'on the site / decode and store / WakeCap reads and serves'. Lightning video: 'WIRELESS MESH' with no Modbus. Lightning sensor path wording also differs: umbrella 'A small input module on a mesh node reads Lightning'; lightning video 'A radio node reads the sensor through an input module'. Umbrella uses 'Cloud queues' (plural) and the lightning video 'Cloud queue'.

Modbus appears only in the umbrella (p01 label, narration, caption, 'no Modbus' for gas). The weather and lightning videos never mention it, and the lightning video's diagram says 'WIRELESS MESH' only. The Modbus explanation is on first use in the umbrella as required and word for word as the guardrail has it. The product videos carry no Modbus line, so a viewer of the Lightning video alone gets no sign of the Modbus framing.

Gas cadence is hedged differently. Umbrella states it plainly in narration and the diagram: 'detectors report ... about every half hour', 'WakeCap checks it about every minute'. Gas video softens it: 'every minute or so', 'often half an hour apart'. The gas diagram omits the half hour figure that the umbrella diagram has. G03 is live_today unknown. Pick one hedge.

'Blackline' is first named in the umbrella k04 as page text with no gloss, before the paths section introduces 'vendor'. The gas video glosses it once ('the gas vendor', g11) before the paths diagram. Umbrella viewers meet the name unexplained.

The acknowledge and close statement is hedged differently. Umbrella k04: 'the page says acknowledging or closing is recorded here, with who and when'. Gas g11 states it plainly. Gas g12 then says the timeline and assignee are not available. Use the same attribution to the page, since the frame shows no who or when column.

'Here is the answer, in one strip.' is reused almost verbatim in weather w02 and umbrella c01. 'The page names the offline station. Readiness reads Not ready, and lists why' (weather w05), 'One detector is offline, and the page says so. Readiness reads Not ready, and the list names it' (gas g05) and umbrella s01 are three near copies of one sentence. 'You and your team stay in control' (umbrella z01) repeats a04 'People stay in control'.

Opening hooks all use the same template: a scene, then a question ('Is it safe ...? Where do you look first?', 'The supervisor asks, so what now?', 'What warns the crew first?', 'How would you know?'). Closings all use 'Your next step' (lightning, gas) or 'Next time ... open' (weather) and a 'What is new' list card in three of four. Four videos in a row sound alike.

DIRECTION framing is consistent in the umbrella (badge, ribbon 'DIRECTION . NOT LIVE TODAY', 'could one day', 'The direction:', 'meant to come from'). The captions of a02 and a04 are in present tense ('An assistant proposes. A person approves.'; 'People stay in control') and the diagram guard bar says 'People stay in control: an assistant proposes, a person approves'. Only the ribbon marks them as direction. a01 and a03 captions begin 'Direction:'. a02 and a04 captions do not.

Peak value wording varies for the same report: umbrella 'peak heat index and peak wind speed' and 'peaks, day by day'; weather 'highest heat index and wind speed'; page 'Maximum'. 'Vendor' (videos) vs 'manufacturer' (research safe phrases) vs 'Blackline' (page quote).

'New' is applied unevenly. The umbrella calls the gas status line new (o02). The gas video's own g02 on the same status line is not marked new. The Detectors page (changes: gas-detectors-page, live yes) is not marked new in gas g08. Lightning marks the alarm activity chart 'New' while showing an empty chart.

Wallboard and phone pages: lightning says 'Neither has a menu link. Both open by address.' Gas says nothing about how to reach them, although the research says the gas pages are also not linked from the rail. The two videos describe the same situation differently.

Times: weather w04 says 'Saudi time' plainly on commit evidence (the page prints no zone). Lightning says 'Saudi time' with the page's own 'AST, UTC+3'. Gas shows clock times in frames and says nothing. The two on-screen clocks agree (15:22 on both products), which supports the claim, but the evidence basis differs between the two videos.

Heat index values differ across videos and are all on screen unspoken: 49.5 (weather, umbrella tri), 49.7 (umbrella c01), 50.1 (weather policy), 50.2 (umbrella k01), 41.5 (Project C). The green line 'Last reading was 0 minute(s) ago' next to an online station in the umbrella o02 and 'Last reading was 1 minute(s) ago' in weather w06 are consistent with their frames.

Weather w07 puts a click callout and cursor on the gear while the Select parameters popup is already open, so the 'click' demonstration and the frame disagree. The chapter bar shows 'Weather Station > gear icon' (a click path) over a page the viewer is told only 'you can' use.

coverage.requirement: Umbrella over all environment products (Weather Station, Lightning, Gas under one product)
coverage.where: connected-environment u01 to u03, o01 to o03, p04 and the umbrella diagram
coverage.note: Strong animated canopy, three product cards, four honest chips and a three-project tri. The chips are scoped as the guardrail allows (one backend, one menu and header, same view permission, switched on per project). No frame shows all three in one portal, so the 'one place' idea rests on the diagram and the tri. The chapter bars imply one menu with all three, which is a weak spot. 'One platform' is a loose label that research X01 approves, but it needs the chips next to it each time.

coverage.requirement: Manage plus a detailed eye on the site
coverage.where: connected-environment o01 (Connected Products), o02, c01, g01, c02, k01; chapters 'A detailed eye' and 'Control'
coverage.note: 'Manage' is shown through Connected Products and the Safety Policy. 'Eye' is shown by the answer strip, steps, gas overview and max report. The details drawer, gas detectors, wallboard and phone, and the Lightning alarm history were cut for length, so the 'detailed' part is thin. All three products are not shown as equals: Weather gets two chapters, Lightning one beat (s03), Gas two.

coverage.requirement: Control what happens when something happens
coverage.note: Honestly scoped but narrow. Control is the weather stop-work limits plus recommended steps, and gas Close recorded in WakeCap only (which ends the Control chapter on a limit). Lightning has no control beat (the cabinet lights come first), and gas limits are read-only. A viewer can read 'Set limits' on the team card as covering all three products although the narration says weather. Nothing shows a response to an event across products. Possibly acceptable given what is true. Say so explicitly in the narration if kept ('control today is weather limits and recorded actions').

coverage.requirement: Feeds a future AI agent, honestly framed
coverage.where: connected-environment a01 to a04 and the agent diagram, DIRECTION badge and ribbon
coverage.note: Framing follows guardrail 4 well: 'could one day', 'Building blocks exist for Weather Station only, not Lightning or Gas', 'No assistant runs on any site today', 'A person approves each proposal', 'Safety answers are meant to come from fixed rules'. No tool count, no agent screens, no claim of control. Fixes needed: a01 'Everything lands in one platform' and the column items 'Gas readings', 'Alerts and history' (see contradictions). a02 and a04 captions are in present tense with only the ribbon marking them as direction. About 28 seconds of text-only diagrams at the end. The brief's 'control everything' is correctly not claimed.

coverage.requirement: Multiple integration paths: Modbus-style mesh and the vendor-cloud black box for gas
coverage.where: connected-environment p01 to p04 (paths diagram, three lanes); gas g14, g15; lightning l12, l13; weather w16, w17
coverage.note: Umbrella explains Modbus on first use in the required wording, shows the Lightning input module and separate queue, and names gas as 'a black box to us. No mesh, no Modbus.' The gas video repeats the black-box path with 'vendor cloud only'. Cadence is stated plainly in the umbrella (G03 unknown live). Weather and lightning videos do not mention Modbus at all, so the umbrella alone carries that requirement. The lightning lane label drops 'Modbus style'. The gas video does not say 'no mesh, no Modbus' although a director note claims it.

coverage.requirement: Screens have new changes: each video shows its new screens
coverage.where: weather: gear, Reports, Safety Policy, Connected Products (w07 to w14). lightning: radii map, alarm activity, settings, wallboard and phone (l05 to l11). gas: overview, status line, wallboard, phone, detectors, alerts (g02 to g12). umbrella: o01, o02, g01, c02, k01, k04
coverage.note: Weather, Lightning and Gas each show most of their new screens, with 'New' captions and a list card. Gaps: (1) the umbrella shows no new Lightning screen at all and its 'What is new' list has no Lightning item, although the Lightning assets exist in the lightning folder. (2) The umbrella and gas videos do not show the gas wallboard, phone or Detectors page as new. (3) The new Lightning radii map is blurred so heavily the rings are not visible, so l05 and l06 show a white void and a blur. (4) 'New' is applied inconsistently across videos (see wording). (5) The lightning refreshed tile is never labelled.

coverage.requirement: Videos are stronger than before: story, visuals and voice
coverage.where: all four, mostly weather w09 to w13, gas g08 to g13, lightning l05 to l11, umbrella tri scenes and diagrams
coverage.note: Story is clearly stronger. Each has a concrete hook and one thesis ('A heat number is not an answer', 'what warns the crew first', 'silence is not calm', 'where do you look first'). Spec check passes and lengths are 2:22 to 3:21 at the tool's pace, with the umbrella and weather at the upper limit. Visuals are improved with zooms, spotlight callouts and diagrams, but still weak in places. Tri scenes (umbrella o03, s01, c02; lightning l11) leave the lower half black. Path diagrams (weather w16 to w17, lightning l12 to l13, gas g14 to g15) are a thin strip in a large empty frame. Weather has four consecutive dense Settings pages (about 40 s), gas has six table-heavy beats, the lightning map beats show a blur. The four openings and closings share one template, so the set sounds samey. Voice cannot be judged without the real run, and word counts are at the 2.5 minute ceiling so real pace may overrun.

consistency.overall: The honesty guardrails mostly hold across the four videos. Gas close and acknowledge are consistently 'recorded in WakeCap only' and quote the page. The AI agent is direction only, with Weather-only building blocks. Gas never reads SAFE or is 'one rule set'. Modbus is explained on first use. The projects are kept apart (A, B, C). Fix before the lead's fact-check: (1) umbrella s03 attributes 'only green means safe' to the page while the lightning video says WakeCap treats it that way; (2) umbrella a01 says everything lands in one platform and lists gas readings and alerts history, which the gas screens show as missing; (3) lightning l09b puts 'the radii the alerting service uses' on screen and l06 spotlights 'Set manually until Management Maps supports ...'; (4) station names and the green 'Last reading' line appear in weather openings and w08, 'Held for' shows in lightning and umbrella openings with two different values, and heat-band numbers show in w11 and w12; (5) the 'Never falsely safe' chapter is too broad. Coverage: umbrella, AI direction and integration paths are covered. 'Control' is honestly narrow. The umbrella has no new Lightning screens. Visual layout leaves half-empty tri and diagram frames. Director reports are stale against the spec files (Modbus in lightning, beat counts, a claimed 'not the mesh' clause), so use spec.json and the beatsheets. Nothing here would stop the lead from rendering, but items 1 to 4 should be fixed or explicitly accepted first."
